proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 April 1995 at about 8.30 p.m. the applicant, driving a car, was arrested in Slovenj Gradec by officers of the Special Unit and the Slovenj Gradec Police.
On 6 April 1995, soon after his release, the applicant was admitted to the Slovenj Gradec General Hospital
On 7 April 1995 the applicant went to the Slovenj Gradec Police and made an oral complaint against the officers of the Special Unit concerning the events of 5 April 1995.
Next day, 7 April 1995, the applicant sought medical aid in the Maribor General Hospital.
On 12 April 1995 the Slovenj Gradec Police lodged a criminal complaint against the applicant
on 20 April 1995, the MIA had appointed a ‘working group’ ( delovna skupina ) ... to assess the lawfulness of the procedures
On 15 May 1995 the applicant lodged, through his lawyer, a written criminal complaint ( kazenska ovadba ) with the Slovenj Gradec Police

proceedings.deciding_body: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 17 January 1997 the Public Prosecutor issued a decision dismissing the applicant’s criminal complaint.
On 8 May 1997... the Slovenj Gradec District Court decided not to open a criminal investigation against the applicant.
On 4 December 1997 the Maribor Higher Court upheld her appeal... and opened a criminal investigation against the applicant.
On 17 March 1998 the criminal investigation was concluded with the investigating judge’s decision
His objection was rejected by the Slovenj Gradec District Court on 16 February 1999.
By a judgment of 22 November 1999 the court acquitted the applicant.
On 5 January 2000 the Public Prosecutor appealed against the judgment and on 27 September 2000 the Maribor Higher Court quashed the judgment and remitted the case to a new panel for retrial.
By a judgment of 12 February 2001, the Slovenj Gradec District Court convicted the applicant as charged
Officer M.F. stated in the same criminal investigation
On 9 May 2001 the Maribor Higher Court upheld the conviction
Lastly, on 11 October 2001 the Slovenj Gradec District Court ordered the applicant to pay an additional sum to cover the costs of one of the witnesses

proceedings.deciding_body: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 28 December 1998 the Public Prosecutor filed an indictment against the applicant

proceedings.deciding_body: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office
proceedings.supporting_quote: the Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office ( Okrožno državno tožilstvo ) asked the applicant’s lawyer to add his client’s deposition to the file
on 17 January 1997, a request for an investigation against Matko Aleksander was lodged with the investigating judge in the Slovenj Gradec District Court
